title: 第24章 对拳第25章 横扫
content_zh:
陆沉眉心微皱，打开看了一眼后就明白了。
原来这是裂石帮给韩氏商铺发出的战帖，信中要求韩家商铺每个月上缴三十两白银，或者陆沉跟裂石帮高手斗一场，否则就会砸了韩家商铺。
“这裂石帮怕是冲我来的吧？”
陆沉看完战帖，眼中泛起一丝冷意。
对方明知道陆沉挂靠在韩家商铺，还要发出这封战帖，摆明了是没把陆沉放在眼里。
“裂石帮这是看您突破不久，特意来找麻烦了。”
韩枫苦笑一声，然后说道：“如果您出手，那我们韩家愿意奉上百两纹银，如果您不愿意出手，我就只好去请到其他师兄帮忙，只是往后这供奉……”
“没关系。”
陆沉摇了摇头，平静的说道：“把银子送来，这战帖我接下了。”
“您不接也没关系，此事我也能理……”
韩枫开口说着，突然愣了一下：“等一下，您说什么？”
“我接。”陆沉平淡道：“给裂石帮主回信，就说明天下午，城南擂台上我与他一战。”
韩枫心中一惊：“您才刚突破明劲，那裂石帮主可是明劲大成。”
“不用担心。”
陆沉摇头，平静的说道：“武是杀人技，绝非只看境界，若单纯以境界论胜负，那低阶武者遇到高阶武者干脆自杀算了。”
“我既然应战，自然是心中有数。”
“这……”韩枫有些迟疑，还是咬牙道：“那我就给他回消息。”
送走了韩枫，陆沉回到屋中。
此时，正在屋里给陆沉做饭的张氏走了出来，面色担心的道：“儿啊，要不推了吧。”
“那裂石帮主作恶多端，我担心……”

“娘，不用担心。”
陆沉摇头，神色平静的道：“裂石帮欺负我们家多年，正好趁这次机会一起算账。”
“而且我练拳多时，总归是要打上一场的。”
没过多久，陆沉被沈衡唤了过去。
武馆内堂中，沈衡端坐在主座上，有些凝重的看向陆沉道：“这裂石帮的人，多半是冲着我来的。”
陆沉愣了一下，但很快反应了过来。
那沈衡端起茶尝了一口，眼中幽幽的道：“这才几天，他们就坐不住了，想要试探我的虚实。”
陆沉眉心微皱，然后说道：“您的意思是，他们想要借着与我约战，看看您的反应？”
“嗯。”
沈衡颔首，然后说道：“所以这一战不仅要打，还要赢得漂亮，不行就让你四师兄上吧，他刚突破明劲巅峰，有十足把握取胜。”
陆沉摇头道：“武是吞金兽，弟子缺钱少粮，这一百两银子，还有每月十两供奉，是在不敢轻言放弃。”
沈衡闻言，先放下茶杯道：“你有把握？”
陆沉道：“弟子服用朱果突破的，实力绝非初入明劲，而且近来还吃了一颗黑鳞狼心脏，实力小有进展。”
听他这么说，沈衡不由点了点头。
朱果的药力极为旺盛，一枚抵得上明劲十年功力，陆沉如果能全部消化的话，突破明劲大成怕是都不成问题，更何况陆沉最近还买了不少丹药和宝肉。
于是沈衡略作沉吟，然后说道：“擂台比武不准带兵器，你的铁甲功防御应该不成问题。”
“既然你要试一试，那我就不多说什么。”
“只是一切要小心，切记不可冲动。”
……
content_en:
Lu Chen frowned slightly, and he understood after opening it and taking a look.
It turned out that this was a war message sent by the Split Stone Gang to Han's shop. The letter required Han's shop to hand over thirty taels of silver every month, or Lu Chen had a fight with a master of the Split Stone Gang, otherwise the Han shop would be destroyed.
"Is this Stone Split Gang coming for me?"
After Lu Chen read the battle post, there was a hint of coldness in his eyes.
The other party clearly knew that Lu Chen was affiliated with Han's shop, yet he still sent out this war message, which made it clear that he did not take Lu Chen seriously.
"The Cracked Stone Gang saw you breaking through soon and came here to cause trouble."
Han Feng smiled bitterly, and then said: "If you take action, then our Han family is willing to donate a hundred taels of silver. If you are unwilling to take action, I will have to ask other senior brothers to help, but in the future, this offering..."
"It doesn't matter."
Lu Chen shook his head and said calmly: "Send the money, I will accept this invitation."
"It doesn't matter if you don't answer, I can handle it..."
Han Feng spoke and was suddenly stunned for a moment: "Wait a minute, what did you say?"
"I'll take it." Lu Chen said calmly: "Reply to the leader of the Split Stone Gang and tell him that I will fight with him in the south of the city tomorrow afternoon."
Han Feng was shocked: "You have just broken through Ming Jin, and the leader of the Split Stone Gang has achieved great success in Ming Jin."
"Don't worry."
Lu Chen shook his head and said calmly: "Martial arts is a killing skill, and it does not only depend on the realm. If the victory or defeat is judged solely on the realm, then low-level warriors will simply commit suicide when they encounter high-level warriors."
"Since I accepted the challenge, I naturally knew what was going on."
"This..." Han Feng hesitated, but gritted his teeth and said, "Then I will reply to him."
After sending Han Feng away, Lu Chen returned to the house.
At this time, Mrs. Zhang, who was cooking for Lu Chen in the room, came out and said with a worried look: "Sir, why don't you push it away."
"The leader of the Split Stone Gang has done many evil things, I'm worried..."
"Mom, don't worry."
Lu Chen shook his head and said calmly: "The Split Stone Gang has bullied our family for many years, so we just took this opportunity to settle the score together."
"And I've been practicing boxing for a long time, and there's always a fight."
Not long after, Lu Chen was called over by Shen Heng.
In the inner hall of the martial arts hall, Shen Heng was sitting on the main seat. He looked at Lu Chen solemnly and said, "Most of the people from the Split Stone Gang are here for me."
Lu Chen was stunned for a moment, but quickly reacted.
Shen Heng picked up the tea and took a sip, and said with a faint look in his eyes: "It's only been a few days, but they can't sit still and want to test my strength."
Lu Chen frowned slightly, and then said: "You mean, they want to see your reaction by challenging me to fight?"
"Yeah."
Shen Heng nodded, and then said: "So this battle must not only be fought, but also won beautifully. If not, let your fourth brother fight. He has just broken through the peak of Ming Jin and is fully confident of winning."
Lu Chen shook his head and said: "Wu is a gold-eating beast. This disciple is short of money and food. With these one hundred taels of silver and the ten taels per month as offerings, I dare not give up easily."
After hearing this, Shen Heng put down his tea cup and said, "Are you sure?"
Lu Chen said: "The disciple who took Zhu Guo to break through is definitely not the first to enter Ming Jin. Moreover, he also recently ate a black-scaled wolf heart, and his strength has improved slightly."
Hearing what he said, Shen Heng couldn't help but nodded.
The medicinal power of Zhu Guo is extremely strong. One pill is equivalent to ten years of Ming Jin's skill. If Lu Chen can digest it all, it may not be a problem to reach Ming Jin's peak. What's more, Lu Chen has recently bought a lot of elixirs and precious meat.
So Shen Heng pondered for a moment, and then said: "Weapons are not allowed in the ring competition. Your iron armor defense should not be a problem."
"Since you want to give it a try, I won't say anything more."
"Just be careful in everything and remember not to be impulsive."
